rationale: The assistant identified transit bolts straight away, asked the customer to check the back, and gave safe removal steps (unplug, keep bolts, fit caps, level). It correctly said no part was needed and that retailer or warranty contact is only for persistent problems. Minor weaknesses are that it speculated about who removed the 4th bolt (the customer installed it herself), repeated the levelling advice, and called the remaining vibration normal without much hedging.
